case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your offer and for your openness about your costs. We value the many years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies and want a fair solution for both sides.

Two points need to be clarified first:

Your letter of 11 September 2026 (doc:20260911-70110-P01) gives 51 days' notice, while our contract (ctr:4600070110) requires 90 days.
Your quality was 712 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70110@2026Q3).

In the spirit of partnership, we would like to propose the following. Longer payment terms are traded against price, so please choose whichever suits your company best.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 132.33; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 133.08; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 134.57; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 90 days net.

I would be glad to talk it through with you personally.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

While we take your quality feedback very seriously and have factored it into our revised offer, we cannot sustain our operations with a delay until April 2027. 

Our current offer is a price of €138.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: €135.40 per unit, a price of €135.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. 

Please note that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This proposal remains valid for 30 days. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Quality Manager: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

Guten Tag,

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. It is always a pleasure to serve Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to continue the long relationship between our companies. We take great pride in our foundry's craftsmanship and look forward to delivering the quality you expect from us.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Quality Manager: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.
